messages:
sara: Morning handoff — quick recap of last 12h.

sara: 03:12 pager from incident-bot: high p95 latency in us-west (model-gen). Root cause: routing instability + one degraded nodepool.

incident-bot: [pager] P1 -> /incidents/2026-03-12-591: RTT p95 > 1.2s for routes serving us-west. Alerts: gateway-queues, nodepool-5 OOM-like evictions. Pager: @oncall.

mike_ops: saw it around 03:08, confirmed repeated BGP flaps from cloud-provider. Started soft-failover to dedicated pools, disabled autoscaler to avoid flapping.

tasha: actioned drain on nodepool-5 at 03:21: `kubectl drain nodepool-5 --ignore-daemonsets --grace-period=30` then Cordon. Shifted ~18% traffic off.

leo_oncall: customer impact: a handful of enterprise customers reported slow responses; no 5xxs. We notified cs-team at 03:30. Logged customer ack ids in the incident doc.

sara: current status (04:00): routing stabilized, p95 back to baseline in us-west for ~22m, nodepool-5 remains cordoned and under investigation. Autoscaler still off. No active pages.

tasha: next steps: run heap-profiler on one evicted instance, collect `/var/log/redwood/agent.log` and kv-cache metrics. Upload to incident doc: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/incidents/591

mike_ops: operational todo: schedule rolling nodepool-replace for nodepool-5 tomorrow 02:00-04:00 PT. Add canary before mass shift: `route set canary us-west-2:canary-01 -> 5%` then monitor 15m.

sara: coverage note: gap between 02:00-04:00 PT tomorrow — our oncall schedule currently has only primary (mike_ops) listed; need explicit secondary. @ops-rotation-bot can you create a reminder and block?

ops-rotation-bot: reminder created -> @mike_ops (primary), request secondary volunteer. Slack reminder set for 2026-03-13 01:30 PT.

mike_ops: I can be primary for that window, tasha can you cover secondary? If yes, add to rota.

tasha: yes can do secondary for that window. :thumbsup:

sara: runbook pointers for next shift -> https://redwood.company/runbooks/traffic-failover (follow steps 2-5 for soft failover), and internal playbook for node evictions: https://redwood.company/runbooks/node-eviction-checklist

leo_oncall: I'll follow up on customer postmortem and craft a short blurb for cs. Leaving notes in the incident doc.

sara: handing off — current assignees: primary: mike_ops, secondary: tasha, followups: leo_oncall (customer comms), eng-ml (heap + model perf triage). No active pages, monitor dashboards for 4h. Ping here if regression.

mike_ops: ack. I'll post a short alert if p95 creeps over 800ms for >5m.

tasha: ack. Thanks. :coffee:

incident-bot: incident 591 -> status: mitigated -> next update: postmortem draft in 24h.
